prompt: This WHO ECDD critical review of MDMB-4en-PINACA (2020) is cited for the items below. Report each exactly as printed, and say 'not found' for any that is absent: (a) how paper infused with the substance reached Scottish prisons (for example by mail or post); (b) which drugs products containing it were sold as or marketed as (for example heroin, cannabis or THC), with the countries named. Do not quote any passage longer than 15 words.
answer:
**(a) Scottish prisons:** The report states that MDMB-4en-PINACA was "infused onto paper that was mailed to inmates in Scottish prisons." It cites Norman et al. (4). The report also says inmates inserted small pieces of this paper into e-cigarette devices for vaping, but it gives no further detail on the mailing route.

**(b) Products sold or marketed as drugs:** The report says MDMB-4en-PINACA was detected in products marketed as heroin and cannabis in the United States and in Wales. It also describes the substance as an adulterant in substances marketed as heroin or cannabis/THC. The specific countries named are the United States of America and Wales.
